column3: A squad-feasibility fix that traded calibration across the season: early-season worse (gw4 -0.0755, gw8 -0.0253), every cohort from gw12 on better (+0.014 to +0.027), roughly three to one against the early half. Reconstructed 2026-08-26 from the assembled series; the commit itself gives no hint it would touch the model's calibration at all, and the record already treated it as a mover of chip figures without knowing why.

Shipped MinutesWeight at 1.0 — a deliberate scoring-constant change, so movement was intended. The signature fits: all eight cohorts shifted down together (-0.009 to -0.018) rather than trading against each other, which is what a level change in a shared constant looks like. Reconstructed 2026-08-26; the size was not stated anywhere at the time.
